boundary: Original load_panel completes, then a controlled AdmissionComplete boundary stops before gateway or search dispatch. All admission checks run unchanged.
command_argv:
import json, os, sys, time
from unittest.mock import patch
os.environ.pop("NLTK_DATA", None)
from pilot import __main__ as cli
started = time.monotonic()
original = cli.load_panel
class AdmissionComplete(Exception): pass
def admission(args):
    selected = original(args)
    print(json.dumps({"selected_panel": selected, "entrypoint": "pilot.main", "launch_NLTK_DATA_supplied": False, "execution_limits": cli.execution_limits(), "model_calls": 0, "final_test_labels_read": False, "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started}), flush=True)
    raise AdmissionComplete
sys.argv = ["pilot", "pilot", "--controls", "evidence/pilot/controls-7b", "--seed", "0", "--out", ".pilot-runs/pilot-seed0-9"]
with patch.object(cli, "load_panel", side_effect=admission):
    try: cli.main()
    except AdmissionComplete: pass
    else: raise AssertionError("Admission completion boundary not reached")
